description: Oregon Fourth Congressional District Candidate Monique DeSpain reacted to an investigative news report published by the Willamette Week laying out troubling text message exchanges between Rosa Cazares, then CEO of the corrupt cannabis company La Mota, and then BOLI Commissioner Val Hoyle. The story detailed an inappropriately close pay-to-play relationship between the head of a state agency responsible for overseeing an employer that was facing dozens of worker complaints and owed hundreds of thousands of unpaid taxes while seeking federally-funded grants for its non-profit ENDVR.
